9999-ERROR-HANDLER ends the program only when WS-ERROR-COUNT > 100; otherwise it returns to the performer, so a failed OPEN does not stop processing. WS-COUNTERS (including WS-ERROR-COUNT) is INITIALIZEd in 1200-INIT-PROCESSING after the opens. Recorded as found

program_narrative: Program UTLMNT00 is a batch file-maintenance utility driven by a control file. It opens CONTROL-FILE for input and ARCHIVE-FILE and REPORT-FILE for output, resets its counters, then reads CONTROL-FILE sequentially until end of file. For each control record it dispatches on CTL-FUNCTION: ARCHIVE, CLEANUP, REORG or ANALYZE each copy CTL-FILE-NAME into WS-VSAM-NAME and then perform two or three step paragraphs (open/archive/close, analyse-space/delete-old/update-catalog, export/delete-define/import, collect-stats/generate-report) that are not present in the source, so the actual maintenance work cannot be traced. Any other function code, and any failed OPEN, is reported through 9999-ERROR-HANDLER, which counts the error, displays the message on the console and stops the program with return code 12 only after more than 100 errors. At the end the three files are closed.

-- Process every control record
WHILE NOT end_of_control DO  -- PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-CONTROL (test before); END-OF-CONTROL means WS-END-OF-CTL = 'Y'

  ELSE
    CALL 2100-process-function
  END IF
END WHILE

pseudocode: -- Dispatch one control record by its function code

-- Dispatch one control record by its function code
SELECT CASE ctl_function
  WHEN ws_archive:  -- 'ARCHIVE'
    CALL 2200-archive-process
  WHEN ws_cleanup:  -- 'CLEANUP'
    CALL 2300-cleanup-process
  WHEN ws_reorg:  -- 'REORG'
    CALL 2400-reorg-process
  WHEN ws_analyze:  -- 'ANALYZE'
    CALL 2500-analyze-process
  ELSE:
    SET ws_error_message = 'INVALID FUNCTION SPECIFIED'
    CALL 9999-error-handler
END SELECT
